page.notes: The right-margin notes are small and partly cut off; "Suar. in[?]" and "pufc. difp. 1." are doubtful readings, probably "Suar. in" and "Suar. disp. 1." A mark (asterisk or similar) may stand before "pufc." and is not clearly legible. "Iehovam" and the quotations are italic. The catchword "mini" completes "congregemini".
